name: adk
purpose: TypeScript SDK (@wave-av/adk on npm) letting AI agents see, produce, and deliver live video via 5 ready-made agent templates, 10 MCP tools, and framework adapters for Mastra/LangGraph/LiveKit/Kernel.sh.
capabilities: 5 agent templates: StreamMonitorAgent, AutoProducerAgent, ClipFactoryAgent, ModerationAgent, CaptionAgent (README.md)

10 MCP tool definitions via AgentToolkit.toMCPTools(): wave_create_stream, wave_monitor_stream, wave_create_clip, wave_switch_camera, wave_show_graphic, wave_moderate_chat, wave_start_captions, wave_analyze_quality, wave_mark_highlight, wave_control_camera (README.md)
AgentRuntime v2 production lifecycle: health/ready/metrics HTTP endpoints, 30s heartbeat, structured JSON logging, graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT handling (README.md)
Framework adapters: createMastraTools, createLangGraphTools, createLiveKitWaveTools, createKernelTools (README.md)
CLI binary wave-adk (package.json bin field -> dist/cli/index.mjs)
MCP server usable from any MCP client via npx @wave-av/mcp-server (README.md)
claims: Published on npm as @wave-av/adk, currently at version 1.0.2 (package.json)
Package is ESM-first with dual esm/cjs build output via tsup (package.json scripts.build, exports field)
While an agent runtime is running it exposes GET /health, GET /ready, GET /metrics (README.md agent lifecycle section)
Usage-based pricing starting at $19/month per README.md 'Why WAVE ADK' section (product claim, not verified against a live billing config in this repo)
